exposure: second- and third-trimester gestational weight gain
weight gain below the 2009 Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommended rates
weight gain within the 2009 Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommended rates
weight gain above the 2009 Institute of Medicine (IOM) recommended rates
cohort: 931 normal weight women with twin pregnancies in Fujian, China, from 2014 to 2018
finding: Gestational weight gain rates above or below the IOM recommendations in the third trimester were associated with some adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Caesarean section risk was decreased in women with weight gain less than the recommended rate in the third trimester.
